schema.description: Access to electricity, rural (% of rural population)
Access to electricity, urban (% of urban population)
Poverty headcount ratio at the international poverty line (% of population)

yaml:
electricity_poverty:
  table: core_tbl
  description: Electricity access, poverty and income, by country and year.
  dimensions:
    year:
      expr: _.year
      description: Year
    country:
      expr: _.country
      description: Country
    iso3:
      expr: _.iso3
      description: ISO3 code
    region:
      expr: _.region
      description: Region
    subregion:
      expr: _.subregion
      description: Subregion
    income_group:
      expr: _.income_group
      description: World Bank income group
  measures:
    avg_electricity_access:
      expr: "_.electricity_access.mean()"
      description: Access to electricity (% of population)
    avg_electricity_access_rural:
      expr: "_.electricity_access_rural.mean()"
      description: Access to electricity, rural (% of rural population)
    avg_electricity_access_urban:
      expr: "_.electricity_access_urban.mean()"
      description: Access to electricity, urban (% of urban population)
    avg_poverty_headcount:
      expr: "_.poverty_headcount.mean()"
      description: Poverty headcount ratio at the international poverty line (% of population)
    avg_gdp_per_capita_ppp:
      expr: "_.gdp_per_capita_ppp.mean()"
      description: GDP per capita, PPP (constant 2021 international $)
    avg_primary_enrolment:
      expr: "_.primary_enrolment.mean()"
      description: School enrollment, primary (% gross)
    avg_rural_population:
      expr: "_.rural_population.mean()"
      description: Rural population (% of total population)

queries.label: Richer, more connected, less poor

chart_spec.title: Electricity access and extreme poverty by income group, 2000-2023

queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    "t1"."income_group",
    AVG("t1"."electricity_access") AS "avg_electricity_access",
    AVG("t1"."poverty_headcount") AS "avg_poverty_headcount"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM "core" AS "t0"
    WHERE
      "t0"."income_group" <> 'Unclassified'
  ) AS "t1"
  GROUP BY
    1
) AS "t2"

queries.label: Low-income countries over time

chart_spec.title: Low-income countries - electricity access and extreme poverty

queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    "t1"."year",
    AVG("t1"."electricity_access") AS "avg_electricity_access",
    AVG("t1"."poverty_headcount") AS "avg_poverty_headcount"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM "core" AS "t0"
    WHERE
      "t0"."income_group" = 'Low income'
  ) AS "t1"
  GROUP BY
    1
) AS "t2"
ORDER BY
  "t2"."year" ASC

queries.label: The rural gap

chart_spec.title: Rural and urban access to electricity by region, 2000-2023

queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    "t1"."region",
    AVG("t1"."electricity_access_rural") AS "avg_electricity_access_rural",
    AVG("t1"."electricity_access_urban") AS "avg_electricity_access_urban"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM "core" AS "t0"
  ) AS "t1"
  GROUP BY
    1
) AS "t2"
